coverageContext: Complete 22-term UK Biobank penalized-regression model for coded disorders of bilirubin excretion. Covariate-adjusted partial correlations in European evaluation groups were modest (about 0.057–0.072); non-European results were near zero or uncertain. This is not a serum bilirubin measurement, Gilbert syndrome diagnosis, UGT1A1 diplotype test, or basis for medication selection or dosing. GA preserves the genetic sum without reproducing clinical covariates or calculating disease probability.
